effects.printed_clause: When activated: optionally add a Wicked Puppeteer monster from Deck. Each-effect HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation with HOPT optionally searches/confirms one set-matching monster if the Field Spell resolves on field.

official_references.matched_structure: Field Spell activation carries an optional archetype search operation.

effects.printed_clause: While controlling a Ritual, replace destruction of own Wicked Puppeteer monster(s) by battle/opponent effect by banishing one Extra Deck card face-down. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Field DESTROY_REPLACE filters own face-up archetype monsters and opponent-caused destruction, checks Ritual and one Extra card, manually flags once per turn, and banishes one face-down as replacement.

effects.printed_clause: If Orchis leaves due to opponent effect: add Tragedy and a Wicked Puppeteer monster from Deck. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed field trigger recognizes either actual/treated Orchis previous code and opponent effect, requires one of each Deck class, then adds/confirms both; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Opponent-caused leave/destruction trigger with delayed follow-up.

coverage_override.reason: The activation search, destruction replacement, and opponent-caused Orchis leave-field two-card search are the three distinct effects; the 'each effect' limits are included in their records.
